SearchFormDefinition.name: SearchDefItemOnlyFinderWithItemTypeFilter
SearchFormDefinition.Source: select im.itemKey, im.itemNumber, im.description, fgs.name, im.businessEntity.businessEntityName from Item im left outer join im.functionalGroups fgs

Text.name: itemNumber
Text.Expression: upper(im.itemNumber) like upper(:itemNumber) and upper(im.itemType) not in ('CFG','PI','S','M')
